title: Uploads

# Uploads

## Library files

1. `POST /api/records/upload-url` with `{ name, mime, size }`.
2. PUT the file bytes to the returned `uploadUrl`.
3. `POST /api/records` with `kind: "upload"`, `fileKey`, `name`, `mime` and
   `size`.
4. Poll extraction status if the document needs OCR or transcription.
5. Ask or read once the document is searchable.

Limits: regular records up to 500 MB; the Supabase fallback is capped at 5 MB.

## Course video

1. `POST /api/stream/upload-url` with the course, title, file name, MIME and
   size.
2. PUT to the returned upload URL.
3. `POST /api/stream/upload-complete`.
4. Poll `/api/stream/status/{videoId}` until encoding completes.
5. Play from `/api/stream/videos/{videoId}`.

Encoding is queued and asynchronous. Do not assume immediate playback.
